info.title: Ashlr Stack CLI
info.summary: Machine-readable catalog of the Ashlr Stack CLI (and MCP tool surface).
info.description: This static documentation catalog represents selected local stack CLI commands as GET operations for discovery; it is not a running HTTP API or an exhaustive CLI surface. Source of truth is packages/cli/src/commands/*.ts, mirrored in packages/site/src/lib/cli-ref.generated.ts. The catalog version label does not establish a published or installed package version. Reviewed source is 0.3.0; the published 0.3.0 CLI and MCP packages declare Node.js 20 or newer; inspect other releases’ engines. The recorded public version is 0.3.0. Launching the MCP server also requires stack on PATH or STACK_BIN; the MCP setup example is in /mcp.json. Inspect actual installed help, advertised tools and returned results. MCP forwards CLI stdout and any nonempty stderr as text; it is not a sandbox or redaction layer. Local MCP resources, when present in the server cwd, return raw file text; emitted provider credential placeholders are literal, not generally expanded by Stack.

servers.description: Documentation and discovery location only; these paths are not HTTP endpoints. The stack CLI runs locally; MCP setup requires both CLI/server commands and the runtime appropriate to the installed versions.

get.summary: Scaffold a .stack.toml in the current directory.
get.description: Creates local .stack.toml and .stack.local.toml files; this does not attest Git commit or ignore state. A selected template can also run provider setup. --noInteractive skips the picker but does not override an explicitly selected template. Phantom requirements depend on subsequent operations.

parameters.description: Starter template slug (e.g. nextjs-supabase-posthog).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Overwrite an existing .stack.toml.

parameters.name: noInteractive
parameters.description: Skip the template picker; an explicitly supplied template can still be used.

200.description: Parsed committed-file reference after scaffolding, not literal CLI JSON stdout or an HTTP response. stack init prints human-facing messages; this catalog retains the JSON media entry only to describe the file representation.

get.summary: Remove a service from the stack.
get.description: Removes local service and MCP configuration and attempts Phantom secret cleanup. Upstream resources are kept in every mode; --keepRemote is a compatibility flag. Headless cleanup or refused terminal confirmation can leave secrets stored. Inspect reported leftovers; command completion does not prove complete teardown.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Service name. Omit with --all to remove every service in this stack.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Remove local entries for every configured service; typed confirmation is requested only in a terminal. Phantom secret cleanup can be partial.

parameters.name: keepRemote
parameters.description: Accepted compatibility flag; upstream resources are kept regardless of this flag.

200.description: Local removal report; inspect any kept secrets or failures. Upstream resources are not deleted.

get.description: Prints configured provider/resource/region/auth and MCP metadata plus secret-name inventory; attempts a fresh healthcheck only when the adapter implements one. Metadata and name presence are not credential validity or universal health proof.

parameters.name: service

parameters.name: sub

get.summary: Show the service dependency graph for this stack.

get.summary: Inspect supported configured-service healthchecks and their report.
get.description: Reports checked, unchecked, warning and error states. --fix attempts setup for eligible failures but can skip stored vault names; inventory presence does not prove credential validity. Setup confirmation depends on the terminal, and headless setup can proceed without that prompt. --all uses recorded local registry projects, not a whole-machine scan. Inspect the report and failures.

parameters.description: Attempt supported setup remediation for eligible failures; stored vault names can cause skips.

get.summary: Pick the right providers for a free-text project description.
get.description: Returns scored curated-provider hits and per-category ranking for a project description. The default selection is pure BM25 retrieval without LLM inference. --save writes a Recipe; --synth attempts optional model-authored rationales. --json prints the CLI RecommendOutput payload, which the MCP server forwards as text rather than a structured MCP result. Inspect completion and output; this is not a latency or zero-I/O guarantee.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text description (positional in the CLI; omit for usage hint).

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Max top-level hits to return.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Restrict to a single category.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: Machine-readable JSON output.

parameters.name: save
parameters.description: Freeze the result to .stack/recipes/<id>.toml for later `stack apply`.

parameters.name: synth
parameters.description: Call a local SLM to synthesize rationales. Falls back to retrieval-only if no endpoint is reachable.

get.summary: Apply a saved recipe through provider setup, a Phantom vault check and webhook stubs.
get.description: Runs the saved Recipe through provider setup, then reports which declared secrets are in the Phantom vault and which are missing (names only; it never writes to the vault) and writes webhook stubs. Inspect failures and skips; complete setup is not guaranteed. --noWire skips the vault check and stubs, not provider credential writes. Requires local Stack configuration; partial failures can require manual cleanup.

parameters.name: recipeId
parameters.description: Recipe id (filename stem in .stack/recipes/). Omit for an interactive picker.

parameters.name: noWire
parameters.description: Skip the Phantom vault check and webhook stubs; provider credential writes remain.

200.description: Apply summary (each provider's add result + phantom-wire counts).

StackToml.title: .stack.toml (canonical committed shape)
StackToml.description: JSON-like representation of the parsed committed .stack.toml produced by writeConfig, not raw TOML text, the merged readConfig result, or every input the permissive reader accepts. Per-clone instance data lives in .stack.local.toml. This reference does not add runtime schema validation.

version.description: emptyConfig starts at version 1; writeConfig preserves the supplied string. The reader does not enforce a version enum or migration promise.

services.description: Map from logical service slot name to its committed provider, secret names and optional MCP entry name. Instance fields are not written here.

provider.description: Provider key; readConfig does not validate it against the provider registry.

secrets.description: Secret slot names, not the corresponding credential values. An empty array is allowed.

mcp.description: Optional MCP server entry name; its presence alone does not attest a running server.

environments.description: Environment entries preserved by writeConfig, including an empty array. This schema does not enforce exactly one default or promise expansion of overrides.

ServiceEntry.title: Merged internal service entry
ServiceEntry.description: Internal ServiceEntry returned by readConfig and the addService library pipeline, combining committed shape with per-clone instance fields. It is not the committed service subset or a literal stack add JSON response. Freeform metadata is not a redaction or secret-storage boundary.

provider.description: Provider key; the service map key is the logical slot name.

secrets.description: Secret slot names associated with this service.

created_at.description: Instance timestamp string; this reference does not add date-format validation.

meta.description: Optional freeform provider-specific instance metadata; values are not generally redacted or moved into Phantom.

RecommendOutput.title: RecommendOutput
RecommendOutput.description: CLI JSON payload printed by stack recommend --json; the MCP server forwards that output as text. This schema is documentation, not a structured MCP result or installed-version attestation.

query.description: The exact free-text query that was scored.

hits.description: Top-k scored providers (ranked across all categories).

name.description: CLI-facing name (what you type after `stack add`).

matched.description: Terms from the query that matched this provider.

byCategory.description: Per-category ranking (top candidates per category, for agents that want a structured plan).

guidance.description: One-paragraph next-step guidance for the user / agent.

path.description: Absolute path to the written recipe TOML.

ProviderEntry.description: One curated provider Stack knows how to wire.
